subject.title: fix(agents): truncate tool results before overflow compaction

question: Should tool-result-heavy generic overflows persistently truncate tool output before attempting model-driven compaction by default?
rationale: Both orders are technically valid but trade user-visible latency against preserving richer tool output through summarization, and repository policy treats fallback/default changes as an explicit product choice.

options.title: Approve truncation-first default
options.body: Land the bounded one-shot heuristic after refreshing the branch and obtaining green required checks.

options.title: Keep compaction-first policy
options.body: Close the PR and retain the current preference for summarization before persistent transcript reduction.

options.title: Request a narrower trigger
options.body: Keep the PR open while defining additional evidence or thresholds that must be met before persistent truncation can precede compaction.

recommendation.title: Approve truncation-first default
recommendation.body: Land the bounded one-shot heuristic after refreshing the branch and obtaining green required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history owns the surrounding cause-aware precheck and overflow-recovery policy most directly.
